description: Deterministic consistency, privacy, replacement, and freshness gates for live Apple Messages snapshots.

cases.criterion: A macOS background privacy denial names Full Disk Access, the exact executable, and the protected source path instead of emitting an opaque SQLite failure.
The read-only online snapshot includes committed messages still present only in chat.db-wal and emits body-free freshness metadata.
Each verified live snapshot replaces only the iMessage projection so source deletions propagate without disturbing other source kinds.
A missing or privacy-blocked live database preserves the last known good snapshot and canonical projection while recording degraded health.
A valid-schema but unexpectedly empty candidate cannot replace a populated last known good snapshot or canonical projection.
A failed directory render cannot leave canonical iMessage state ahead of the restored last-known-good snapshot.
Manual and scheduled Apple Messages refreshes share the same single-writer lock as Instagram and Facebook.
The private macOS LaunchAgent runs hourly and at login from Application Support using a snapshotted runtime.
Operator status exposes bounded freshness, counts, and failure state without message bodies.
Every hourly snapshot closes its SQLite descriptors so repeated launchd runs do not leak resources.
